title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Premium Payment and Refund Payee Rules
content:
1. **Full premium.** NFIP premium on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) is payable in full for the term: the full premium accompanies the application and no installment plan exists.
2. **Methods and application.** A payment is accepted only by one of the accepted payment methods and is applied to the policy and term named on the payment; it is never moved to another policy of the same customer.
3. **Escrow.** When a lender pays from escrow the payment method is escrow disbursement and the policy's premium payor is the lender's escrow.
4. **Underpayment.** When the amount received at application is less than the total term premium, Tidemark sends an underpayment notice and the policyholder has the tier's underpayment cure period in calendar days from the notice to pay the difference; if the difference is not received, the limits are reduced to the amounts the premium received will buy and the difference is not pursued.
5. **Overpayment.** When the amount received exceeds the total due, the excess is refunded to the payor in the same way as a cancellation refund.
6. **Dishonor.** A dishonored payment is reversed and, when it was the application premium, the policy is nullified for a dishonored premium payment.
7. **Refund payee.** Every refund is paid to the payor of record.

| Premium payor of record | Refund payee |
|---|---|
| the insured | the insured |
| the lender's escrow | the lender's escrow |

## Cases (hypothetical amounts)

- Application premium received 2,000.00 against a total term premium of 2,300.00: an underpayment notice goes out; if the 300.00 difference is not received within the cure period, the limits are reduced to what 2,000.00 buys and the 300.00 is not pursued.
- Received 2,500.00 against 2,300.00 due: the 200.00 excess is refunded to the payor of record.
- Escrow-paid policy: any refund is paid to the lender's escrow, not to the insured.
